Sports Broadcaster Andrés Cantor Moves to Netflix for Women's World Cup

Veteran sports broadcaster Andrés Cantor has signed with Netflix to cover the 2027 Women's World Cup. Cantor, known for his signature "¡GOOOOL!" call, spent 26 years at Telemundo before making the move to the streaming platform. This marks a new phase in his career, bringing his Emmy Award-winning commentary to a new audience.
